Per protocol, since the witness confidence is above 7/10 and the external text concurs, the answer is straightforward.

## Final Answer

**Yes**, the peritoneum is present. Both the parietal peritoneum (pale membranous cavity lining) and the visceral peritoneum/serosa (covering the bowel loops) are visible in this opened abdominal cavity.
